thought.text: Let me perform an actual end-to-end web login to confirm the full stack integration.

reasoning_content:
Let me perform an end-to-end login via next-auth credentials callback to confirm the web app can authenticate against the API. This tests the full stack integration (frontend -> API -> DB).

Also check the AdminApi uses API_BEARER_TOKEN and API_DOMAIN. In the dev (tooling) frontend, API_DOMAIN is http://api? Wait dev runs in tooling container where API_DOMAIN from .env.local = http://api. Let me test the login.

action.command: cd /tmp; rm -f naj.txt; CSRF=$(curl -s -c naj.txt -m 20 http://localhost:3000/api/auth/csrf | sed 's/.*"csrfToken":"//;s/".*//'); echo "csrf=${CSRF:0:16}..."; echo "=== POST credentials callback ==="; curl -s -b naj.txt -c naj.txt -m 30 -o /tmp/cb.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/credentials -d "csrfToken=$CSRF&email=club-admin-1@example.org&password=password&json=true&callbackUrl=http://localhost:3000/en/admin"; echo "--- callback body ---"; cat /tmp/cb.txt | head -c 300; echo; echo "=== session after login ==="; curl -s -b naj.txt -m 20 http://localhost:3000/api/auth/session | head -c 500; echo

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp; rm -f naj.txt; CSRF=$(curl -s -c naj.txt -m 20 http://localhost:3000/api/auth/csrf | sed 's/.*\"csrfToken\":\"//;s/\".*//'); echo \"csrf=${CSRF:0:16}...\"; echo \"=== POST credentials callback ===\"; curl -s -b naj.txt -c naj.txt -m 30 -o /tmp/cb.txt -w \"HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\\n\" -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/credentials -d \"csrfToken=$CSRF&email=club-admin-1@example.org&password=password&json=true&callbackUrl=http://localhost:3000/en/admin\"; echo \"--- callback body ---\"; cat /tmp/cb.txt | head -c 300; echo; echo \"=== session after login ===\"; curl -s -b naj.txt -m 20 http://localhost:3000/api/auth/session | head -c 500; echo", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "End-to-end web frontend login test"}
